note: Owner-facing supplier profiles. Policies referenced here are the ones the code applies (tests/supplier-profiles.test.cjs keeps them in sync). Prices are never invented: no RRP column → no RRP.

suppliers.name: M-WIN
suppliers.rrp_source: rrp | price_rrc | recommended_price tag (oldprice is not RRP)
suppliers.size_source: param Розмір/Размер; nets: param «ОБЕРІТЬ РОЗМІР СІТКИ:» W×H (rule m-win-net-grid-v1, camouflage_nets only)
suppliers.group_source: offer@group_id (nets: one colour per group, sizes inside)
suppliers.model_family_evidence: group_id + identical title after the own W×H size is removed
known_exceptions: «Індивідуальний розмір (ціна за 1 кв.м.)» is a per-m² price: MODERATION price_unit, never a fixed item price
feed date in the private sample is 2026-04-08: use a fresh file for production

suppliers.name: Tactical Belt
suppliers.availability_source: offer@available → Наличие есть/нет; quantity_in_stock → Stock (validation only, private)
known_exceptions: available=true with quantity 0, or false with quantity > 0 → UNKNOWN (contradiction)
exact supplier quantity is never published

suppliers.name: UKR-TEC
suppliers.rrp_source: none (the export has no RRP; pricing uses cost only under the 30/25/20 policy)
suppliers.size_source: title/description only (no size column) → SIZE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED unless explicit
suppliers.model_family_evidence: none in the file: cross-supplier/name matches stay in MODERATION or the import queue
known_exceptions: positive integer in Наявність = delivery days → PREORDER (manager confirmation)

suppliers.name: Киборг
suppliers.group_source: offer@group_id = colour or size slice of a model
suppliers.model_family_evidence: group code + strong identity (single code or ≥3 latin tokens + identical description ≥200)
known_exceptions: several camouflage names are not in the colour dictionary (owner proposal)

suppliers.name: Армолайн
suppliers.group_source: offer@group_id = colour slice of a model
known_exceptions: available="" is нет (OUT_OF_STOCK), as the feed's own Наличие param confirms
